description: Fetch BLS time-series data in a single API request (one query). SeriesIDs are trimmed, uppercased, and deduplicated in first-occurrence order. Processes up to 25 unique IDs without a key or 50 with one; unprocessedSeriesIds names the exact remainder for a separate request. Supports optional year range (up to 20 years; BLS may reduce it) and BLS-computed net/percent changes when available. BLS can publish a '-' missing-value sentinel; check observation.available before arithmetic. Set annual_average to add BLS-computed annual summary rows, which are not additional periods or universally arithmetic means. Large results spill to a dataframe when canvas is configured; otherwise all observations return inline. Use dataset.name in bls_dataframe_describe, then bls_dataframe_query SQL. Use bls_search_series to resolve concepts to SeriesIDs.

annual_average.description: When true, include BLS-computed annual summary rows named "Annual": M13 for monthly series, Q05 for quarterly, S03 for semiannual. These are not universally arithmetic means or additional periods; exclude them from sums or averages over periods. Defaults to false. Independent of year bounds. Surveys without annual summaries return the same rows either way; annualAverageRows reports the count.

calculations.description: When true, request BLS-computed period-over-period net/percent changes. BLS returns supported types and intervals; some surveys omit calculations while preserving observations, while an explicit unsupported-calculations rejection raises calculations_not_supported. Consult bls_list_surveys for support. Monthly series may return 1, 3, 6, and 12-month intervals. Mirror rows carry no calculations. calculationsApplied is false when any data-bearing series returns no calculation values; notice names affected series and available calculations remain intact.

end_year.description: End year for the data range (inclusive). Supplying it without start_year is rejected before the request — BLS applies no default start year alongside an explicit end year. Pair it with start_year, or omit both for the API default window.

series_ids.description: BLS SeriesIDs, trimmed, uppercased, and deduplicated in first-occurrence order. Process up to 25 unique IDs without a key or 50 with one; the exact remainder is returned as unprocessedSeriesIds. The batch costs one API query.

start_year.description: Start year for the data range (inclusive). BLS allows up to 20 years per request and requires both bounds or neither: supplying start_year alone resolves end_year to the current year, capped at start_year + 19. BLS may reduce this window for unregistered access. Omit both for the BLS three-calendar-year default, subject to series coverage.

name: bls_get_series

annualAverageApplied.description: Whether annual-average rows were requested. When false, observations hold real periods only; filter on available before aggregation.

annualAverageRows.description: How many observations across all series are annual-average rows (period M13/Q05/S03). Present only when annual_average is true; 0 means none of the requested surveys publish annual averages.

availableObservations.description: Rows with a published numeric value.

calculationsApplied.description: True when calculations were requested and every data-bearing series returned calculation values. False when disabled, no observations returned, or any data-bearing series lacks calculations; notice names affected series. Absent when calculations was omitted.

dataset.description: Canvas dataframe handle — present when the observation volume exceeded the inline budget. Call bls_dataframe_describe with dataset.name to inspect column_schema, then use that table name in bls_dataframe_query SQL across the full data.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 per-table expiry, fixed at creation; the enclosing canvas has a separate sliding lifetime.

name.description: Canvas table name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX). Pass to bls_dataframe_describe first to inspect column_schema, then use it in bls_dataframe_query SQL.

row_count.description: Total rows in the canvas table.

endYearApplied.description: End year applied to the query. Resolved from start_year when end_year was omitted, so it can differ from the requested range; notice names the cap when the 20-year window decided it. Absent when no year range was in effect.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `service_unavailable`: BLS is unreachable or returns an unsuccessful HTTP response and no mirrored observations can answer the request. `serialization_failure`: BLS returns malformed JSON and no mirrored observations can answer the request. `upstream_timeout`: The live BLS request exceeds its shared 45-second operation budget and no mirrored observations can answer the request. `invalid_api_key`: BLS rejected the configured BLS_API_KEY as invalid. `quota_exceeded`: The BLS API 500 query/day limit has been reached. `request_rejected`: BLS returned a non-success status with a message matching no known failure mode, both for the request and for its automatic re-issue without catalog metadata — e.g. a rejected combination of request parameters. `series_not_found`: No requested series returned data and at least one SeriesID does not exist. A batch mixing an invalid SeriesID with one BLS has no data for lands here too, and names both in the message and recovery hint. For an OEWS SeriesID, usually an occupation–area cell BLS does not publish, the hint names the state or national row to request instead of bls_search_series. `series_locked`: The BLS database is temporarily locked for the requested series. `no_data_for_period`: The requested year range is unusable before the request — start_year after end_year, a span of 20 years or more, or end_year without start_year — or BLS returned data for none of the requested series over the range. `calculations_not_supported`: calculations=true was requested for a survey that does not support it. `canvas_registration_failed`: The result set exceeds the inline budget and canvas is configured, but registering the dataframe failed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance for agents — names any SeriesID that returned zero observations with its reason (including a failed live fallback's reason and recovery for a SeriesID the local observation mirror does not hold, and the state or national row to request for an OEWS SeriesID BLS reports nonexistent), names mirror-served series that lack requested calculations, reports a resolved end_year the 20-year window capped, and reports the bls_dataframe_describe then bls_dataframe_query workflow when results spill to canvas. Absent when every requested series returned data over the window as asked and it all fit inline.

items.description: Time-series data for one BLS series.

area.description: Geographic area when returned by the API.

availableObservationCount.description: Rows with a published numeric value, excluding the BLS "-" sentinel.

item.description: Item/subject when returned by the API.

measure.description: Measurement type and units supplied by BLS.

observationCount.description: Total period rows for this series, including unavailable BLS placeholder rows. When spilled to canvas, all rows are on the dataframe; inline only shows a preview.

observations.description: Inline observations. All observations when no spillover; preview rows when spilled to canvas.

available.description: False when BLS published the "-" missing-value sentinel for this period.

footnotes.description: Footnote codes and text, when present.

period.description: BLS period code: M01–M12 are months, Q01–Q04 quarters, S01–S02 semiannual halves. M13, Q05 and S03 are BLS-computed annual summaries, named "Annual", and appear only when annual_average is true. They are not additional periods or universally arithmetic means. Exclude them from sums or averages over periods.

value.description: Raw observation value from BLS. The literal "-" means unavailable; check available before arithmetic and read footnotes for the reason.

seasonal.description: Seasonality indicator when returned by the API.

title.description: Series name when returned by the API.

seriesRequested.description: Number of SeriesIDs requested. Do not compare it against series[] length to find empty series — a SeriesID that returned no data is still listed in series[] with observationCount 0. Check observationCount per entry, or read notice, which names every SeriesID that came back empty.

spilled.description: True when results spilled to canvas due to inline budget overflow.

startYearApplied.description: Start year applied to the query, whether it was served live or from the local observation mirror. Absent when no year range was in effect.

totalObservations.description: Total observation rows across all requested series.

unavailableObservations.description: Rows carrying the BLS "-" missing-value sentinel.

unprocessedSeriesIds.description: Canonical unique SeriesIDs beyond the request cap, in original order. Request these separately.

title: Get BLS Time-Series Data
